text:
Priya: @here bringing up a new model for onboarding + perf: lyra-9b (oss/lyra v0.1). Goal: quick smoke for throughput/latency, quant check (int8), and regression sweep against our chat/regression harness. Asking for P2 prioritization — want hosted + dedicated profiles validated before next sprint. Details: ~9B params, hf id: lyra/lyra-9b-v0.1, tokenizer: byte-level BPE (commit 6a3f).

Aaron: I'll pick this up. Proposed smoke matrix: batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16], ctx lengths [512,1024,2048,4096], quant modes [fp16,int8]. Run tokens/s and p50/p95 latency. Will run on p3d-perf pool.

BenchBot: auto: bench job created -> b-342, queue: p3d-perf, owner: Aaron, matrix: quick-smoke. Link: https://perf.internal/jobs/b-342 :gear:

Aaron: quick command I'm running locally for repeatability:
```
rbench run \  
  --model lyra/lyra-9b-v0.1 \  
  --quant fp16,int8 \  
  --batch 1,2,4,8,16 \  
  --ctx 512,1024,2048,4096 \  
  --metrics throughput,latency \  
  --warmup 3 --iter 20
```

Aaron: initial smoke (fp16, p3d-perf, batch 1/8, ctx 512/2048) - raw tail lines:
- fp16 | batch=1 ctx=512  -> p50=95ms p95=220ms throughput=520 tok/s
- fp16 | batch=8 ctx=512  -> p50=190ms p95=380ms throughput=4200 tok/s
- fp16 | batch=8 ctx=2048 -> p50=720ms p95=1200ms throughput=1850 tok/s
- int8 | batch=8 ctx=512  -> p50=160ms p95=320ms throughput=5100 tok/s
Notes: int8 improves tokens/s ~20-25% for large batches, but p95 tail still sensitive to ctx size.

Mia: quick quant note: ran a small eval on our convo-quality set after int8 conversion (post-PTQ). Observed ~1.1% drop on conv-quality F1 and a ~0.8% drop on MMLU microavg. Need full eval run vs our regression suite before we accept int8 default. Possible cause: mlm head reorder in the export step, tokenizer mapping might differ (Priya mentioned commit 6a3f).

Jasper: re: regressions, please add the following to the intake checklist run before promoting quant model:
1) run regression-harness v2 (includes convo-quality, tox, hallucination probes)
2) tokenization checksum compare: `python tools/token_check.py --hf-model lyra/lyra-9b-v0.1`
3) compare logits nat-sort for 100 random prompts to baseline

Jasper: sample regression command:
```
./tools/regress_run.sh \  
  --model-path /models/lyra-9b/fp16 \  
  --eval-sets convo-quality,mmlupaper,qa-squad \  
  --out /tmp/lyra-regress.json
```

Sam: infra items: add model to routing whitelist (rule: lyra-9b -> dedicated pool fallback to lyra-9b-quant if capacity), set canary percentage 5% for first 24h, enable fallback to costa-7b if p95 > 2s. Also we need a capacity estimate: Aaron, can you run a throughput/req-sim to estimate QPS for 1k users with typical token distribution?

Aaron: will run a small sim tonight. Preliminary back-of-envelope: for chat-like workload avg 64 tokens/resp, batch8 fp16 throughput ~4200 tok/s -> ~65 req/s per GPU. So 1k concurrent users (active) ~= 15-20 GPUs for hosted target (rough estimate, will provide breakdown).

Priya: tagging owners and next steps: Aaron (perf smoke + capacity sims), Mia (quant full eval & PTQ tuning), Jasper (regression harness + token checks), Sam (routing/canary config). Priya will coordinate docs + console entries. Target: have canary-ready by EOD Friday (3-day run).

Aaron: noted. I'll upload bench artifacts and perf heatmaps to the job link when done.

Mia: if int8 regression >1.5% we should block default quant and iterate PTQ params (calibration set size). I'll start with 2k calibration examples.

Jasper: FYI added token-check script to the PR diff; Priya can you ensure the tokenizer commit is pinned in model manifest?

Priya: pinned (manifest PR opened, will link).

BenchBot: auto: b-342 completed stage 1 -> artifacts: https://perf.internal/artifacts/b-342/summary.json :white_check_mark:

Aaron: uploaded summary + heatmap gif. Quick callout: batch 4 is the sweet spot for latency/throughput tradeoff at ctx <=1024. For ctx >=2048 memory paging increases p95.

Sam: noted. I'll prepare routing rule draft and share for review.

Priya: thanks all — keeping this thread as the primary intake. Please post any blocker replies here. :eyes:

Jasper: ack

Mia: ack :seedling:

Aaron: ack :rocket:
